description: Austin, TX – Speaker Dustin Burrows appointed State Rep. Trey Wharton (HD-12) to the Texas House Committee on Corrections and the Committee on Insurance. title: RELEASE: Speaker Appoints Rep. Trey Wharton to Prominent Committees - Trey Wharton For Texas State Representative District 12
